CustomField.label: MCP Schema
CustomField.description: MCP Tool definition (JSON: name, title, description, inputSchema, outputSchema, annotations), precomputed by ApexAgentToolSchemaRegenQueueable alongside Schema__c and served as-is by the MCP tools/list endpoint. Regenerated after insert, after Apex_Class_Name__c or Modifies_Salesforce_Data__c changes, and on demand via the Regenerate Schema quick action. Written together with Schema__c and left unchanged when generation fails, so a prior valid definition is never overwritten with a broken one. History-tracked like this object's other fields; note Long Text Area history records only that the value changed, not its full before/after text.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Precomputed MCP tool definition (with output schema and annotations) served to MCP clients. Read-only — use the Regenerate Schema quick action to refresh it.
